directions: From Westside Galway test centre, depart to the right onto Bóthar Le Cheile and follow it for about 280 metres
At the end of the road turn left onto Siobhan McKenna Road, then at the next end of road turn left onto Circular Road
At the following end of road turn right onto Rahoon Road, which continues straight ahead as Bishop O'Donnell Road
At the first roundabout take the exit for Western Distributor Road, bearing left, and stay on the Western Distributor for a good stretch
